text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle

g.text: Performance and geometry aligned by nominal SNR
Top: original-probability AUROC, equal mean across six fixed noises within each of three checkpoints, then across checkpoints.
Bottom: geometry median, IQR and 5th–95th percentiles; condition offsets are display-only around nominal 0/5/10 dB.
This is a parallel display—not equal exposure, causal mediation, or new patient uncertainty. E/I and modes retain original weights.
